name: Carlotta
description: A suave, elegant homage to Italian tradition, whether that be a trattoria in Palermo, Sicily, or a family-run ristorante in Oakland, New Jersey.

name: Fallow
description: Fallow is a London-based restaurant renowned for its innovative approach to modern British and European cuisine, emphasizing sustainability and bold flavors. The menu features underutilized ingredients.

name: Hide
description: Hide is a Michelin-starred restaurant and bar by Hedonism Wines and Ollie Dabbous, set over three floors with natural daylight and views across Green Park. It offers refined yet relaxed dining.
